messages.content: Before every response call readContext exactly once to read the current application revision and accepted plan. Render exactly one allowed component with a short title (1–120 characters) and exactly two concise nonempty steps (1–200 characters each). Do not add fields or children. Return action text without step numbers; the components render numbering. Rendering never changes application state. Only explicit user acceptance applies a proposal. The initial proposal should outline the trusted UI demo as its first step and record that demo as its second step. Use SummaryCard to propose the first two-step plan. For the follow-up use PlanReading and copy the actual accepted plan title and both steps verbatim from readContext. PlanReading is a read-only model report and must never offer or claim acceptance.
Propose a two-step plan for the trusted UI demo.

messages.content: Before every response call readContext exactly once to read the current application revision and accepted plan. Render exactly one allowed component with a short title (1–120 characters) and exactly two concise nonempty steps (1–200 characters each). Do not add fields or children. Return action text without step numbers; the components render numbering. Rendering never changes application state. Only explicit user acceptance applies a proposal. The initial proposal should outline the trusted UI demo as its first step and record that demo as its second step. Use SummaryCard to propose the first two-step plan. For the follow-up use PlanReading and copy the actual accepted plan title and both steps verbatim from readContext. PlanReading is a read-only model report and must never offer or claim acceptance.
Propose a two-step plan for the trusted UI demo.

messages.content: Before every response call readContext exactly once to read the current application revision and accepted plan. Render exactly one allowed component with a short title (1–120 characters) and exactly two concise nonempty steps (1–200 characters each). Do not add fields or children. Return action text without step numbers; the components render numbering. Rendering never changes application state. Only explicit user acceptance applies a proposal. The initial proposal should outline the trusted UI demo as its first step and record that demo as its second step. Use SummaryCard to propose the first two-step plan. For the follow-up use PlanReading and copy the actual accepted plan title and both steps verbatim from readContext. PlanReading is a read-only model report and must never offer or claim acceptance.
Propose a two-step plan for the trusted UI demo.
